name: Onboarding Carousel
description: A four-step React Native onboarding where a swipe moves a day forward: the sky blends dawn to golden hour, SVG hills parallax and a grove grows under a glass card.

props.name: brand
props.description: Wordmark centred in the top bar.

props.name: steps
props.description: Kicker, title, body, clock minutes, a three-stop sky gradient and a glass chip (breath | focus | week | reminder) per step. Three or four steps read best.

props.name: skipLabel
props.description: Top-right glass pill; jumps to the last step through every sky in between.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Button label on every step but the last.

props.name: finishLabel
props.description: Button label on the last step.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Label after the final press, while the flourish plays.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Called about a second after the final press, once the leaves have settled.
